exercises.name: Seated Chest Flys (Cable)

source_english.description: Sit between chest-height cable pulleys and sweep both handles together in front of the sternum before opening the arms.
instructions: Sit centered between two chest-height cable pulleys with a handle in each hand.
Keep a small bend in both elbows and open the arms level with the chest.
Sweep both handles forward until the hands meet in front of the sternum.
Reverse the same arc until the chest is gently stretched.
common_mistakes: Using momentum instead of the target joint path.
source_english.safety_note: Use a secure setup and stop if alignment or control is lost.

source_english.description: A Smith-machine standing calf raise lifts both heels with the bar supported across the upper back.
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to stand with your feet flat on the ground and your shoulders under the bar.
Position yourself under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on the bar for stability.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
form_cues: Keep the ankle vertical over the foot.
Rise evenly through the balls of both feet.
common_mistakes: Rolling the ankles outward or inward.
Bending the knees to create momentum.
source_english.safety_note: Use the machine, rack, or wall only for balance and keep the load light enough to control the ankle range.
